title: Classifying submodules over monoidal categories
summary: We study the classification of submodules of module categories over monoidal categories, extending ideas of Coulembier on the classification of tensor ideals in monoidal categories. We develop a framework that applies to module categories equipped with a twisted cylinder twist, a structure closely related to the twisted reflection equation and quantum symmetric pairs. Under mild assumptions, we establish an order-preserving bijection between submodules of a module category $\mathcal{M}$ and submodules of the path-algebra module $\mathcal{M}(1,-)$.
